documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in partner support. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in partner support, reporting that their workflow stopped after a configuration change. They explicitly state this is a support incident and request that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The operational friction they describe is a workflow disruption caused by a configuration change.
raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Since this is a support incident, we will escalate it to the support team for immediate resolution. Once the issue is resolved, we can revisit any discussions about expansion or further integration if needed.
questions: Can you provide any additional details about the configuration change that caused the workflow disruption?
Have you already contacted the support team, or would you like us to escalate this to them directly?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is unknown.
The current status of the support escalation is not confirmed.
